verdict.rationale: Phaser ships an official AI-native capability: the Phaser Game Agent MCP server integrates with Claude Desktop, Cursor, GitHub Copilot and other MCP tools, letting users describe changes in plain language (e.g. 'give the player a double-jump') and have the agent call engine tools, plus a dedicated phaser.io/agent chat assistant for scaffolding games. This directly matches generating scripts/answering API questions/scaffolding scenes described in the story, and is first-party documented with 40+ specialized tools. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community corroboration of the AI assistant's real-world reliability, and clarity on whether it's gated behind the paid editor tier rather than free/open engine use.
